newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan plastics stocks rise, rebounding from lows.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan plastics stocks rise, rebounding from lows.

text.p: Taiwan's plastics issues rose in late Wednesday trade in a rebound from low levels hit during recent market consolidation, brokers said.
Fifty minutes before the close, the plastics sector had gained 0.97 percent, with USI Far East up 50 cents or 1.72 percent at T$29.5 and Nan Ya Plastics rising T$1 or two percent to T$51.5.

"Their share prices have hit pretty low levels...gains should be just rebounds as there has been no significant change in the industry's demand and supply," said Mike Tsai of Grand Cathay Securities. -- Taipei Newsroom (2-5080815)
